YOGA GUIDANCE, RIGHT ON YOUR PHONE

A calm coach that watches your form.

Open your camera, move into a pose, and get gentle, instant feedback on your alignment, spoken aloud in English, हिन्दी or বাংলা. No sign-up. Nothing to install.

1
Prop up your phone

Stand about two metres back, in good light, with your whole body in view.

2
Move into a pose

Practise freely, or pick a pose to work on and get checked against it.

3
Adjust with gentle guidance

Watch your score and hear what to change, one small step at a time.

Everything a good practice partner does, nothing it doesn't.
Knows the pose you're in

Just practise. AsanaAI recognises what you are doing, so there is nothing to select.

A score you can watch

See how close your alignment is, live, and which joint to adjust first.

Guidance you can hear

Gentle spoken cues in English, हिन्दी or বাংলা, so you never have to look at the screen.

Fits your body

It learns how far your joints naturally move, so feedback is about you, not an ideal.

Keeps going without internet

After your first visit, basic recognition and tips still work offline.

Private by design

Your video stays on your device. Nothing is recorded, and there is no account.

Start with six foundational poses.

Each one has a short guide in the app: what to line up, and what to feel.
